  - The price shown at Review is the price charged (it's stamped into the order), so a
    card order settles at the sold price.
  - You're online in about a minute — no technical setup required for managed products.

PROVISIONING LIFECYCLE (what "getting ready" means)
  1. Order placed → the service is created in a PENDING / provisioning state and a
     background provisioning job is queued.
  2. The provisioner builds it — a VPS/game server VM boots (typically ~90 seconds);
     shared hosting is set up right away. Work happens as background jobs (one in-flight
     job per server), so occasionally a step queues briefly behind another.
  3. Service goes LIVE (RUNNING) and appears in your dashboard with its IP / connection
     details / root password.
  4. Point your domain (A record to the IP, or our nameservers; or connect Cloudflare).
  5. SSL is issued automatically once the domain resolves to us — HTTPS turns on with
     nothing to configure, and auto-renews.
  6. For managed sites you can then 1-click install WordPress (or another app), open the
     control panel, or use Build with AI.
